# Recommended GitHub Repository Settings

These settings live in GitHub, not in git. Use this as the source text for the repository sidebar and topics.

## About

**Description**

Game-ready 2D sprite toolkit: web app, CLI, and MCP server for collision polygons, pivots, tags, pixel art, normal maps, palettes, atlases, and GIF export.

**Website**

Use the production app URL when it is final. Until then, keep the README as the homepage:

```text
https://github.com/trebeljahr/sprite-tools#readme
```

## Features

- Enable Issues.
- Enable Discussions when you want Q&A separate from bugs.
- Enable Dependabot alerts and security updates.
- Enable private vulnerability reporting if available.
- Add releases from npm-published tags.
